columns.name: SOURCE_TRACKING_ID
columns.description: Primary key for the Source tracking table.

columns.name: AGENCY_NAME
columns.description: Column to store Name for Agency.

columns.name: AGENT_NAME
columns.description: Full Name of an Agent.

columns.name: SOURCE_LEVEL
columns.description: will contain the source level value for the given record

columns.name: DIMENSION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the dimension definition. (IRC_DIMENSION_DEF_B)

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_CODE
columns.description: The campaign code pointing to the IRC_CAMPAIGNS_B table.

columns.name: REQUISITION_ID
columns.description: The requisition ID that is stored in the IRC_REQUISITIONS_B table.

columns.name: FROM_REQUISITION_ID
columns.description: The requisition ID that is stored in the IRC_REQUISITIONS_B table. Used for the add to req from another requisition.

columns.name: TOKEN_ID
columns.description: The related token ID to is stored in IRC_CX_CNDT_EMAIL_TKNS table.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_ID
columns.description: The submission ID that is stored in the IRC_SUBMISSIONS table.

columns.name: PROSPECT_ID
columns.description: The related token ID to is stored in IRC_PROSPECTS table.

columns.name: REFERRAL_ID
columns.description: The referral ID that is stored in the IRC_RF_REFERRALS table.

columns.name: RECRUITER_ID
columns.description: The person id related to the recruiter that is stored in the PER_PERSONS table.

columns.name: POOL_ID
columns.description: The pool id that is stored in the HRT_POOLS_B table.

columns.name: CANDIDATE_NUMBER
columns.description: The person id related to the internal candidate that is stored in the IRC_CANDIDATES table.

columns.name: SHARE_ID
columns.description: The share id that is stored IRC_RF_SHARES table.

columns.name: PARENT_SOURCE_TRACKING_ID
columns.description: The parent source tracking id pointing to the same table IRC_SOURCE_TRACKING. table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FROM_POOL_ID
columns.description: The pool ID that is stored in the HRT_POOLS_B table. Used for the add to pool action from another candidate pool.

columns.name: POOL_MEMBER_ID
columns.description: The pool member id related to pool member that is stored in the IRC_CAND_POOL_MEMBERS table.

columns.name: SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Foreign key to the IRC_CX_SITES_B table.

columns.name: AGENT_ID
columns.description: The Agent Id that is stored in the IRC_AGENTS

columns.name: AGENCY_ID
columns.description: The Agency Id that is stored in the IRC_AGENCIES

columns.name: REFERRED_DATE
columns.description: Date of referral by the Agency

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_POST_ID
columns.description: Post id of the social campaign posts. Foreign key to IRC_CAMP_ASSETS_B

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the status of the of the Source tracking record

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: The id of the event that the candidate is currently part of. The Event ID that is stored in the IRC_REC_EVENTS_B table.

columns.name: FROM_EVENT_ID
columns.description: The id of the event from which the candidate is added. Foreign key to IRC_REC_EVENTS_B.

columns.name: INACTIVATION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the Sourectracking record is inactivated
